title: Design: with No locations a Totals row of $0.00 shows
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open documents in these reports at two locations, {Location-A} and {Location-B}, and you are enrolled at both; {Location-A}'s name comes first in A to Z order.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • Starting screen: A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu in light theme at 100% zoom.
  • The design picture "Cleared: No locations" (ar-ap-p4-cleared-no-locations.png) is attached to this case and open beside the browser at 100% zoom; compare the layout, labels and styles, not the names and amounts, which are only examples.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. In the Location menu, click "Clear selection".
  2. Close the menu.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: "Location: No locations".
  • Step 2: the menu closes, and under the column headings a "Totals" row reads $0.00 and $0.00, then the empty state, as in the picture.

Held: this is the design's version of a difference from the PRD. Question 13 on Chris Ward's question sheet (added 22 Oct 2026) decides it. If the design wins, this case is released and the PRD-following cases change; if the PRD wins, this case is deleted with the QA lead's go-ahead.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R6a: “With no location ticked ("Clear selection" or unticking every row), the report shows no rows: the native empty state (S8-R5) with "Clear all filters", no totals and no Location column. An export from that state downloads nothing and shows "Empty export", "Export didn't yield any results", as on Sales By Customer.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 4 "Location filter and Location column" (board Location.dc.html). This held case follows the design picture below, not the PRD sentence quoted above (Rule 130 item 5): the quote shows what the PRD says today, the picture what the design shows.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p4-cleared-no-locations.png: figure "Cleared: No locations" (This build (after)), board "4. Location filter and Location column"

The design's own words:

  • ""Clear selection" leaves no location chosen: the chip reads "Location: No locations" and stays visible, and the table shows the native empty state "No record matches these filters" with "Clear all filters". S5-R6a, S5-R9." (caption of "Cleared: No locations")

Difference from the PRD (DD-03): the PRD says with no location ticked, "the native empty state (S8-R5) with "Clear all filters", no totals and no Location column" (S5-R6a); the design shows "Location: No locations" with a Totals row reading $0.00 and $0.00 under the headings, above the empty state. This held case follows the design; the difference is question 13 on Chris Ward's question sheet (added 22 Oct 2026); the design version is this case.
